searchText: is it me bugging or latest dora update? that looks like the duty calculation is off, so dora expects another proposer for each slot and marks it as missed.. are you already on devnet 5 specs with the new duty calculation from https://github.com/ethereum/consensus-specs/pull/4039 ? yeah yea, this isn't merged yet 😄 https://github.com/ethpandaops/dora/pull/195 coming soon ahhh oki doki can you retry with this in your kurtosis config? ``` dora_params: image: ethpandaops/dora:master ``` It should have the new duty calculation now, but haven't been able to test it yet without a client 😄 stopped updating on electra start what client images do you use for testing? 🙂 need to take a look myself 😅 teku you mean or dora? teku and probably a compatible el client 🙂 here is our peerdas branch https://github.com/zilm13/teku/tree/das-electra no published docker, but it's built from this branch runnning with following config (changed dora to master for this run) ``` participants: - el_type: geth cl_type: teku cl_extra_params: [ --p2p-subscribe-all-custody-subnets-enabled ] cl_image: consensys/teku:develop cl_min_cpu: 2000 cl_min_mem: 2000 - el_type: geth cl_type: teku cl_image: consensys/teku:develop cl_min_cpu: 2000 cl_min_mem: 2000 network_params: electra_fork_epoch: 1 fulu_fork_epoch: 2 #snooper_enabled: true global_log_level: info additional_services: - dora - goomy_blob - prometheus_grafana # - blob_spammer dora_params: image: ethpandaops/dora:fulu-support ``` yea, issue identified and fix on the way! works fine on my side now, thx for the config 🙂 fixed and updated the `fulu-support` branch too 🙂

excerpts.author: dmitriishmatko
excerpts.content:
runnning with following config (changed dora to master for this run)
```
participants:
  - el_type: geth
    cl_type: teku
    cl_extra_params: [
        --p2p-subscribe-all-custody-subnets-enabled
    ]
    cl_image: consensys/teku:develop
    cl_min_cpu: 2000
    cl_min_mem: 2000
  - el_type: geth
    cl_type: teku
    cl_image: consensys/teku:develop
    cl_min_cpu: 2000
    cl_min_mem: 2000
network_params:
  electra_fork_epoch: 1
  fulu_fork_epoch: 2
#snooper_enabled: true
global_log_level: info
additional_services:
  - dora
  - goomy_blob
  - prometheus_grafana
#  - blob_spammer
dora_params:
  image: ethpandaops/dora:fulu-support
```
